# Code Anchors: Verb Reachability

- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the one registry: every reachable capability's name, summary, usage and runnable, the further-name lists, and the single dispatcher that reads arguments and exits.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — dispatch, usage composition from the registry, and coverage of a verb the real registry does not contain.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/fold-toolkit.spec.ts` — the folded capabilities present as dispatch names, reached with the arguments and flags they accepted before, reporting the executable's program name.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/parity.spec.ts` — parity of un-built source against a fresh build, over every reachable capability.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.spec.ts` — one self-contained artifact per declared binary name, now a single entry point.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-composition.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/component-composition-waivers.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/component-composition.spec.ts` — the structural check deciding which capabilities a component body may reach at all.
- `libs/portable-tools/corpus/bin/gh` — the hermetic committed stand-in a capability driving an external program is compared through, on both sides.
- `libs/portable-tools/corpus/epic-resolve`, `libs/portable-tools/corpus/record-digest` — the committed corpora the parity check replays for the resolver and digest verbs.
- `libs/abs-doc-path/src/resolve.ts`, `libs/abs-doc-path/src/settings.ts`, `libs/abs-doc-path/src/repo-root.ts`, `libs/abs-doc-path/src/normalize.ts` — a capability reachable as a verb without import-time behaviour of its own.
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/cli.ts` — a build-only invoker, which is why it stays source-only and never earns a verb.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/environment-guard.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/environment-guard.spec.ts` — cross-cutting behaviour placed in the dispatcher rather than each verb, which is what covers a verb added later.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts` — the folded resolver's own command table, the source its further names are read from rather than a hand-maintained copy.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts`, `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/run.ts` — the two folded filers, reached as verbs on the one executable.
